tools.name: list_traces
tools.description: List trace ids in a store with task, success flag and step count.

tools.name: attribute
tools.description: Attribute a trace: primary MAST failure mode, confidence, and per-detection evidence. With explain=true the Bayesian fusion arithmetic (prior log-odds + LLR per detection) rides along, so the verdict is auditable.

judge.description: also ask the LLM judge (needs openai + keys)

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify the HMAC evidence chain of a trace. Returns the full verdict payload: verdict (intact, tampered, unsigned, keyed, wrong-key, rolled-back, ledger-broken), detail, chain finals, rollback flag and ledger health.

key_file.description: signing key file for HMAC-keyed traces

all.description: verify every trace in the store and return the tally (trace omitted)

tools.name: survey
tools.description: Fleet summary over one or more store directories: trace counts, failure rates, trend verdicts, token totals.

prices.description: JSON object model -> blended $/1k; adds a per-store est_spend

tools.name: ci_gate
tools.description: Quality-gate verdict over the store: compose ceilings (failure rate, p95/avg step latency, tokens, estimated spend) into one pass/fail an agent loop or pipeline can gate on. Mirrors the `approximately ci` command.

since.description: gate only runs from the last N days

tools.name: init_gate
tools.description: Wire the CI quality gate into a repo directory: GitHub Actions workflow, starter price table, .gitignore line. Idempotent — nothing is overwritten without force.

force.description: overwrite the workflow and price table if present

tools.name: bisect
tools.description: First material divergence between two traces (failed vs last success is the classic use): the step where the failed run left the successful run's path, with worst-ranked divergences.

floor.description: mutations with similarity >= floor count as noise (default 0.8)

tools.name: evidence_pack
tools.description: Write one trace's complete case as a tamper-evident zip: the native record with its integrity chain, the HTML postmortem, annotations, the chain verdict, and a sha256 manifest.

key_file.description: signing key to verify a keyed chain

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Health check of a trace store: corrupt or misnamed records, evidence-ledger tamper, stale locks, leftover temp files, and (with digest_dir) monitoring gaps. With deep, recompute every record's integrity chain.

spool_dir.description: also check a spool directory: pending files and ones no pass could parse

judge_cache.description: also count judge-cache entries and unreadable ones

deep.description: recompute every record's integrity chain — a record can be parseable yet lie

tools.name: spool_once
tools.description: One ingest pass over a spool directory: import every transcript/OTLP file that is waiting, then report counts. Parse-able files move to done/ (or are deleted); unparseable files stay for a human.

delete.description: delete processed files instead of archiving

tools.name: trend
tools.description: Day-level analytics over a watch-loop digest directory: per-day failure rate, sparkline, Theil-Sen verdict. With an agent name, the per-day rollup for that one agent instead (visible while it stays among a store's top-N busiest agents in the snapshots).

agent.description: per-day analytics for one named agent (optional)

tools.name: scoreboard
tools.description: Per-agent rollup for a store: steps, tool calls, errors, tokens, failed traces, and the touched-trace failure rate per agent (steps without identity roll up under unattributed). Optional query-expression filter, e.g. "success == false". min_failed keeps only repeat offenders.

top.description: keep the first N rows (default: all)

min_failed.description: keep only agents with at least N failed traces (default: all)

group_by.description: roll up per agent (default) or per tool

tools.name: cluster
tools.description: Cross-trace failure clustering: attributes every trace and groups failures by (mode, tool-set); min_size keeps only recidivist clusters. by_agent switches to recidivist AGENTS instead of modes. Optional query-expression filter.

by_agent.description: cluster recidivist agents instead of modes

top.description: keep the first N clusters (default: all)

tools.name: similar
tools.description: Most alignment-similar traces to a given trace, best first (structure-aware sequence alignment over steps, score in [0, 1]).

other_store.description: compare against traces in another store

tools.name: drift
tools.description: Behaviour drift between the oldest and newest traces of a store: Population Stability Index over action histograms, with the biggest shifted actions.

baseline_ratio.description: share of oldest traces forming the baseline window (default 0.5)

tools.name: counterfactual
tools.description: Leave-one-out attribution over every detected step of a trace: which step's removal eliminates each mode (root cause vs symptom), distributed-cause verdict and causal ranking.

tools.name: predict
tools.description: Failure precursor score for a trace: mines the store's other traces for action patterns that precede failures, returns a failure probability with contributors.

tools.name: context
tools.description: Context-runtime forecast for a trace: replay the recorded run through a budgeted context window (dry run) - what survives eviction, fact recall, tokens saved.

tools.name: curve
tools.description: Budget-recall sweep for a trace: recall of ground-truth facts across a geometric grid of context budgets (the what-if curve).

tools.name: plan_repair
tools.description: Smallest honest intervention set that clears a trace's failure modes: dedupe repeats, insert verifications, re-attribute. Planning only — the repaired trace is described, not written; whatever still fires needs an agent-level change.

tools.name: import_annotations
tools.description: Merge an annotation sidecar (JSONL) into the store, append-only: rows the store has never seen are added, keyed on stable triage content — a re-import skips.

glob.description: merge every sidecar matching this pattern instead of a single path

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Near-duplicate clusters: traces so aligned they are the same run wearing a different id (import hygiene before a fine-tuning export).

tools.name: status
tools.description: The one-glance ops overview: store health, top failure modes, triage tallies, the last failure with its chain verdict, ledger health, the top recidivist agent and (with digest_dir) the fleet trend verdict. The MCP mirror of `approximately status`.

since.description: only traces created in the last N days

digest_dir.description: also report the fleet trend verdict from this digest history

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Attach an analyst note to a trace (append-only sidecar; the evidence chain stays untouched). With a note: writes it (verdict: confirmed / false-positive are the triage idioms). Without: returns the annotations on file (trace filter optional).

trace.description: omit (with note omitted) to read all annotations in the store; omit with from_anomalies to draft

from_anomalies.description: draft triage notes from the store's fleet latency anomalies (verdicts left empty)

note.description: omit to read instead of write

verdict.description: write: the triage verdict; read: only annotations with this verdict

tools.name: anomalies
tools.description: Robust anomaly detection (modified z-scores over tool-call steps, worst first): latency by default, tokens with the tokens flag. isError is set when anomalies exist.

fleet.description: baseline each tool family across the whole store instead of one trace

tokens.description: meter on tokens instead of milliseconds — burn flags the receipt a retry loop leaves

per_model.description: with tokens+fleet: split each tool family by the trace's model

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Structural diff of two traces (alignment ops + similarity) with the divergences ranked most-different first.

tools.name: regression_test
tools.description: Mint a self-contained pytest regression file from a failed trace (the trace rides along as base64): the failure can never silently return. Returns the file content; write it where your tests live.

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Store health as Prometheus text exposition: trace count, failure rate, step/token means, per-mode failure counts (and per-agent rates with group_by agent).

group_by.description: store totals (default), per-agent or per-tool rates

tools.name: import_transcripts
tools.description: Batch-import foreign transcript JSONL into the store: one transcript per line, shape sniffed from the first line (native Trace dumps, OpenAI chat dumps, bare message arrays). Deterministic ids make re-importing the same file a no-op.

path.description: JSONL file, one transcript per line

format.description: auto (default) / native / openai-jsonl / messages-list / otel (OTLP envelope)

glob.description: import every file matching this pattern instead of a single path

dry_run.description: count what would be imported, write nothing

tools.name: export_transcripts
tools.description: Export traces from the store as foreign transcript JSONL (OpenAI chat shape by default; native is lossless) so fine-tuning and eval pipelines can consume them. Optional shared query-DSL filter.

format.description: openai-jsonl (default) / native / otel (OTLP JSON for Jaeger, Tempo, Honeycomb) / csv (one row per step)

query.description: shared query-DSL filter, e.g. 'success == false and tool=ls'

since.description: only traces created in the last N days

tools.name: scan_tool
tools.description: Static-analysis for a tool description before an agent uses it: spelling tricks, directional-formatting tricks, phrasing that tries to override the operator's instructions.

file.description: path to the tool description (markdown or plain text)

tools.name: bench_gate
tools.description: Attribution-quality regression gate: run the rule detectors over a labeled JSONL dataset and compare per-mode P/R/F1 plus sample macro-F1 against a floors file. Reports violations instead of exiting nonzero.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Deep dive on a MAST failure mode: definition, published share, the mechanical detectors that watch for it, and engineering fixes. Omit the mode for the overview table of all 14 modes.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Aggregate a query selection instead of listing it: count, success split, failure rate, mode totals, mean steps/tokens.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Select traces with an expression, e.g. "success == false and mode == FM-2.1". Derived fields include max_latency (slowest timed tool call), failed_tools and failed_agents (names behind errored calls), e.g. "failed_tools contains 'search' and max_latency > 5000".
